factual_claims.source_evidence: Statement of Comprehensive Income (GROUP) shows Gross profit for 1-9 months 2025: 31,549 thousand EUR vs 29,237 thousand EUR for 1-9 months 2024. Operating profit for 1-9 months 2025: 21,282 thousand EUR vs 18,942 thousand EUR for 1-9 months 2024.

factual_claims.claim: Profit before tax reached EUR 16.186 million, compared with EUR 14.910 million previously, and net profit rose to EUR 13.158 million from EUR 11.862 million.
factual_claims.label: SUPPORTED
factual_claims.source_evidence: Statement of Comprehensive Income (GROUP) shows Profit before tax for 1-9 months 2025: 16,186 thousand EUR vs 14,910 thousand EUR for 1-9 months 2024. Profit for the year for 1-9 months 2025: 13,158 thousand EUR vs 11,862 thousand EUR for 1-9 months 2024.

factual_claims.claim: Basic and diluted earnings per share increased from EUR 0.031 to EUR 0.035.
factual_claims.label: SUPPORTED
factual_claims.source_evidence: Note 17 (Earnings per share) shows Basic and diluted earnings per share for 1-9 months 2025: EUR 0.035 vs EUR 0.031 for 1-9 months 2024.

factual_claims.claim: The main revenue improvement came from LNG terminal services, which generated EUR 43.640 million compared with EUR 31.401 million in 2024.
factual_claims.label: SUPPORTED
factual_claims.source_evidence: Note 13 (Revenue from contracts with customers) shows Income from LNGT regasification services collected directly from LNGT users for GROUP 1-9 months 2025: 43,640 thousand EUR vs 31,401 thousand EUR for 1-9 months 2024.

factual_claims.claim: The report attributes this increase to the terminal’s one-and-a-half-month dry-dock outage in 2024, higher LNG regasification volumes and bonuses from clients for booked capacity.
factual_claims.label: SUPPORTED
factual_claims.source_evidence: Note 13(1) states: 'Revenue from LNG services during the nine months of 2025 is higher, compared to the same period in 2024, due to: (i) the terminal being out of operation for one and a half months in 2024 due to dry-dock repair works; (ii) higher LNG regasification volumes and (iii) bonuses paid by LNGT clients for booked capacity.'

factual_claims.claim: Liquid energy products transshipment revenue also increased to EUR 21.375 million from EUR 20.241 million, while consulting services revenue rose to EUR 7.507 million from EUR 3.961 million.
factual_claims.label: SUPPORTED
factual_claims.source_evidence: Note 13 shows Sales of liquid energy products transshipment services for GROUP 1-9 months 2025: 21,375 thousand EUR vs 20,241 thousand EUR for 1-9 months 2024. Sales of consulting services for GROUP 1-9 months 2025: 7,507 thousand EUR vs 3,961 thousand EUR for 1-9 months 2024.

factual_claims.claim: These gains were partly offset by lower revenue from other LNG terminal activities, which declined to EUR 6.383 million from EUR 11.530 million because clients made fewer payments for unused capacity.
factual_claims.label: SUPPORTED
factual_claims.source_evidence: Note 13(2) states: 'Other sales related to LNG terminals activity lower mainly due to less payments collected from clients for the unused allocated capacities.' Note 13 shows Other sales related to LNG terminals activity for GROUP 1-9 months 2025: 6,383 thousand EUR vs 11,530 thousand EUR for 1-9 months 2024.

factual_claims.claim: Revenue was also reduced by EUR 2.753 million from the proportional repayment of excess returns from regulated activities in 2022–2023.
factual_claims.label: SUPPORTED
factual_claims.source_evidence: Note 13(3) states: 'The decrease in revenue was affected by the reduction of LNG security supplement income in 2025 due to proportionally recognised repayment of the excess returns (surplus income) from regulated activities during the period 2022-2023.' Note 13 shows Income from LNGT services included in security supplement for GROUP 1-9 months 2025: (2,753) thousand EUR (vs 0 in 2024).

factual_claims.claim: Cost of sales increased to EUR 45.115 million from EUR 38.740 million.
factual_claims.label: SUPPORTED
factual_claims.source_evidence: Note 14 (Cost of sales) shows Total cost of sales for GROUP 1-9 months 2025: (45,115) thousand EUR vs (38,740) thousand EUR for 1-9 months 2024.

factual_claims.claim: Depreciation and amortisation rose to EUR 18.335 million from EUR 6.865 million, reflecting the acquisition of the floating storage and regasification unit in December 2024 and the resulting reclassification of its depreciation from right-of-use assets.
factual_claims.label: SUPPORTED
factual_claims.source_evidence: Note 14* states: 'Following the acquisition of the FSRU on 6 December 2024, the asset was reclassified from the right-of-use assets to the Company’s property, plant and equipment. As a result of this change, for the 9 months of 2025, EUR 11,369 thousand of the FSRU depreciation expenses were recognised under “Depreciation and amortisation (incl. amortisation of grants)”.' Note 14 shows Depreciation and amortisation for GROUP 1-9 months 2025: 18,335 thousand EUR vs 6,865 thousand EUR for 1-9 months 2024.

factual_claims.claim: Operating expenses were also higher, at EUR 10.640 million compared with EUR 10.419 million.
factual_claims.label: SUPPORTED
factual_claims.source_evidence: Note 15 (Operating expenses) shows Total operating expenses for GROUP 1-9 months 2025: (10,640) thousand EUR vs (10,419) thousand EUR for 1-9 months 2024.

factual_claims.claim: Despite these cost increases, higher revenue supported the improvement in operating profit.
factual_claims.label: SUPPORTED
factual_claims.source_evidence: Operating profit increased from 18,942 thousand EUR (1-9 months 2024) to 21,282 thousand EUR (1-9 months 2025) despite higher costs, as shown in the Statement of Comprehensive Income and supported by revenue growth detailed in Note 13.

factual_claims.claim: Finance income fell to EUR 1.520 million from EUR 2.644 million, while finance costs were broadly stable at EUR 6.616 million versus EUR 6.692 million.
factual_claims.label: SUPPORTED
factual_claims.source_evidence: Note 16 (Finance income and finance costs) shows Finance income for GROUP 1-9 months 2025: 1,520 thousand EUR vs 2,644 thousand EUR for 1-9 months 2024. Finance costs for GROUP 1-9 months 2025: 6,616 thousand EUR vs 6,692 thousand EUR for 1-9 months 2024.

factual_claims.claim: The weaker net finance result limited the increase in profit before tax.
factual_claims.label: SUPPORTED
factual_claims.source_evidence: Profit before tax increased from 14,910 thousand EUR (1-9 months 2024) to 16,186 thousand EUR (1-9 months 2025). The decline in finance income (from 2,644 to 1,520 thousand EUR) partially offset the operating profit growth, as shown in the Statement of Comprehensive Income and Note 16.

factual_claims.claim: In the third quarter alone, net profit declined to EUR 4.570 million from EUR 10.403 million, and operating profit fell to EUR 7.102 million from EUR 8.888 million despite slightly higher revenue.
factual_claims.label: SUPPORTED
factual_claims.source_evidence: Statement of Comprehensive Income (GROUP) for 7-9 months 2025 shows Profit for the year: 4,570 thousand EUR vs 10,403 thousand EUR for 7-9 months 2024. Operating profit for 7-9 months 2025: 7,102 thousand EUR vs 8,888 thousand EUR for 7-9 months 2024. Revenue from contracts with customers for 7-9 months 2025: 25,581 thousand EUR vs 25,363 thousand EUR for 7-9 months 2024.

factual_claims.claim: Operating cash flow more than doubled to EUR 76.331 million from EUR 35.637 million, including EUR 31.900 million transferred from financial assets to cash.
factual_claims.label: SUPPORTED
factual_claims.source_evidence: Statement of Cash Flow (GROUP) shows Net cash flows from operating activities for 1-9 months 2025: 76,331 thousand EUR vs 35,637 thousand EUR for 1-9 months 2024. The line item 'Reclassification of financial assets to cash and cash equivalents' shows 31,900 thousand EUR for 1-9 months 2025.

factual_claims.claim: Cash and cash equivalents consequently rose to EUR 54.398 million from EUR 17.203 million.
factual_claims.label: SUPPORTED
factual_claims.source_evidence: Statement of Cash Flow (GROUP) shows Cash and cash equivalents on 30 September 2025: 54,398 thousand EUR vs 17,203 thousand EUR on 31 December 2024.

factual_claims.claim: Loans declined to EUR 311.443 million from EUR 320.352 million.
factual_claims.label: SUPPORTED
factual_claims.source_evidence: Note 9 (Borrowings and lease liabilities) shows Total loans for GROUP as at 30 September 2025: 311,443 thousand EUR vs 320,352 thousand EUR as at 31 December 2024.

factual_claims.claim: The company’s standalone net profit also improved, reaching EUR 11.613 million compared with EUR 10.702 million in 2024.
factual_claims.label: SUPPORTED
factual_claims.source_evidence: Statement of Comprehensive Income (COMPANY) shows Profit for the year for 1-9 months 2025: 11,613 thousand EUR vs 10,702 thousand EUR for 1-9 months 2024.
